newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Creyf's buys French regional firms.
newsitem.headline: Creyf's buys French regional firms.

text.p: Belgian temporary employment company Creyf's NV said on Thursday it had acquired two regional temporary employment networks in France.

It said in a statement it bought the 3A company from ATP Associes. 3A, which operates agencies in Lille, Lens, Livry, Gragan, Reims and Metz, is expecting a 1997 turnover of 75 million French francs against 70 million last year.
Creyf's also acquired Picardie Travail Temporaire, which has offices in St. Quentin, Amiens, Laon, Aulnoy and Dunkerque and is expecting a 1997 turnover of 50 million French francs.
Creyf's, which gave no financial details of the acquisitions, had a 1996 turnover of 8.85 billion francs, 1.63 billion accounted for by its French unit Pro Consultant.
